overview: Rui Zhao is an Associate Professor of Biochemistry and Molecular Genetics. Dr. Zhao received his B.S. degree from Peking University in China (1998) and Ph.D. degree from the University of Iowa (2004). He received his postdoctoral training at Children’s Hospital Boston and Harvard Medical School, and joined the UAB faculty in 2012.
